717int __wrap_ioctl(int descriptor, unsigned long request, ...)
718{
719 va_list arguments;
720 void *argument;
721 (void)descriptor;
722 if (!mock_oss_io) {
723 va_start(arguments, request);
724 argument = va_arg(arguments, void *);
725 va_end(arguments);
726 return __real_ioctl(descriptor, request, argument);
727 }
728 if (request == mock_ioctl_failure)
729 return -1;
730 if (request == SNDCTL_DSP_RESET || request == SNDCTL_DSP_SETDUPLEX ||
731 request == SNDCTL_DSP_SETTRIGGER)
732 return 0;
733 va_start(arguments, request);
734 argument = va_arg(arguments, void *);
735 va_end(arguments);
736 if (request == SNDCTL_DSP_GETOSPACE) {
737 struct audio_buf_info *info = argument;
738 memset(info, 0, sizeof(*info));
739 info->fragstotal = mock_oss_fragment_total;
740 info->fragments = mock_oss_fragments;
741 info->fragsize = 3840;
742 return 0;
743 }
744 if (request == SNDCTL_DSP_GETCAPS)
745 *(int *)argument = mock_oss_caps;
746 else if (request == SNDCTL_DSP_SPEED)
747 *(int *)argument = mock_oss_speed;
748 return 0;
749}

966int __wrap_usleep(unsigned int microseconds)
967{
968 (void)microseconds;
969 usleep_calls++;
970 if (clear_eeprom_on_usleep && usbradio_default.next)
971 usbradio_default.next->eepromctl = 0;
972 if (clear_eeprom_target)
973 clear_eeprom_target->eepromctl = 0;
974 if (stop_pulser_on_usleep)
975 stoppulser = 1;
976 if (stop_hid_radio_on_usleep &&
977 ++stop_hid_usleep_count >= (stop_hid_after_usleeps ? stop_hid_after_usleeps : 1))
978 stop_hid_radio_on_usleep->stophid = 1;
979#ifdef URP_TEST_MODERN
980 if (modern_stop_audio_on_usleep)
981 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep->stopaudiothread = 1;
982 if (modern_swap_first && modern_swap_second) {
983 modern_swap_wait_step++;
984 if (modern_swap_wait_step == 1) {
985 modern_swap_first->swap_audio_ready = 1;
986 if (!modern_swap_staggered)
987 modern_swap_second->swap_audio_ready = 1;
988 if (modern_swap_first != modern_swap_second) {
989 modern_swap_first->swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_READY;
990 if (!modern_swap_staggered)
991 modern_swap_second->swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_READY;
992 }
993 } else {
994 modern_swap_second->swap_audio_ready = 1;
995 if (modern_swap_staggered) {
996 modern_swap_second->swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_READY;
997 } else {
998 modern_swap_first->swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_IDLE;
999 modern_swap_second->swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_IDLE;
1000 }
1001 }
1002 }
1003#endif
1004 return 0;
1005}

2666 usbradio_device_identity(&radio, devstr, sizeof(devstr), serial, sizeof(serial), &card);
2667 assert(!devstr[0] && !serial[0] && card == -1);
2668 usbradio_device_identity(&radio, NULL, 0, NULL, 0, NULL);

2670 radio.radio_device = &device;

2672 assert(!strcmp(devstr, "usb-modern"));
2673 assert(!strcmp(serial, "serial-modern"));
2674 assert(card == 7);
2675 usbradio_device_identity(&radio, devstr, 0, serial, sizeof(serial), &card);
2676 usbradio_device_identity(&radio, devstr, sizeof(devstr), serial, 0, &card);
2677 device.serial = NULL;
2678 usbradio_device_identity(&radio, NULL, 0, serial, sizeof(serial), NULL);
2679 assert(!serial[0]);
2680 device.serial = "serial-modern";
2681 usbradio_log_usb_recovered(&radio);
2682 assert(!radio.usb_faulted);
2683 usbradio_log_usb_recovered(&radio);
2684 radio.radio_device = NULL;
2685 radio.usb_faulted = 1;
2686 usbradio_log_usb_recovered(&radio);
2687
2688 radio.radio = &radio_state;
2689 radio.pa.output_channels = 2;
2690 radio.txmixa = TX_OUT_VOICE;
2691 radio.txmixb = TX_OUT_OFF;
2692 usbradio_adjust_txmix_for_mono(&radio);
2693 assert(radio.txmixb == TX_OUT_OFF);
2694 for (int a = TX_OUT_OFF; a <= TX_OUT_AUX; ++a) {
2695 for (int b = TX_OUT_OFF; b <= TX_OUT_AUX; ++b) {
2696 radio.pa.output_channels = 1;
2697 radio.txmixa = a;
2698 radio.txmixb = b;
2699 radio_state.txMixA = a;
2700 radio_state.txMixB = b;
2701 usbradio_adjust_txmix_for_mono(&radio);
2702 assert(radio.txmixa == radio_state.txMixA);
2703 assert(radio.txmixb == radio_state.txMixB);
2704 }
2705 }
2706 radio.radio = NULL;
2707 radio.pa.output_channels = 1;
2708 radio.txmixa = TX_OUT_VOICE;
2709 radio.txmixb = TX_OUT_LSD;
2710 usbradio_adjust_txmix_for_mono(&radio);
2711 radio.txmixa = TX_OUT_OFF;
2712 radio.txmixb = TX_OUT_VOICE;
2713 usbradio_adjust_txmix_for_mono(&radio);
2714 radio.radio = &radio_state;
2715
2716 radio.radio_device = &device;
2717 usbradio_release_device(&radio);
2718 assert(!radio.radio_device);
2719 usbradio_release_device(&radio);
2720
2721 radio.swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_IDLE;
2722 usbradio_swap_begin(&radio);
2723 assert(radio.swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_QUIESCING && !radio.swap_audio_ready);
2724 usbradio_swap_audio_stopped(&radio);
2725 assert(radio.swap_audio_ready);
2726 radio.stophid = 1;
2727 assert(usbradio_swap_hid_wait(&radio));
2728 assert(radio.swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_READY);
2729 assert(usbradio_swap_ready(&radio));
2730 usbradio_swap_finish(&radio);
2731 assert(!usbradio_swap_ready(&radio));
2732 assert(radio.swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_IDLE && !radio.swap_audio_ready);
2733 usbradio_swap_audio_stopped(&radio);
2734 radio.swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_QUIESCING;
2735 radio.swap_audio_ready = 0;
2736 assert(!usbradio_swap_hid_wait(&radio));
2737 radio.stophid = 0;
2738 radio.swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_QUIESCING;
2739 radio.swap_audio_ready = 0;
2740 modern_swap_first = &radio;
2741 modern_swap_second = &radio;
2742 modern_swap_wait_step = 0;
2743 assert(usbradio_swap_hid_wait(&radio));
2744 assert(radio.swap_state == DEVICE_SWAP_IDLE);
2745 modern_swap_first = NULL;
2746 modern_swap_second = NULL;
2747
2748 radio.radio_device = &device;
2749 {
2750 int rx_max, tx_max, sidetone_max;
2751 usbradio_mixer_limits(&radio, &rx_max, &tx_max, &sidetone_max);
2752 assert(rx_max == 100 && tx_max == 100 && sidetone_max == 100);
2753 usbradio_set_sidetone_switch(&radio, 1);
2754 usbradio_set_rx_mixer(&radio, 50);
2755 radio.duplex3 = 500;
2756 radio.duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_HARDWARE;
2757 modern_mixer_element_available = 0;
2758 mixer_write(&radio);
2759 modern_mixer_element_available = 1;
2760 mixer_write(&radio);
2761 radio.duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE;
2762 mixer_write(&radio);
2763 modern_mixer_element_available = 0;
2764 radio.radio_device = NULL;
2765 usbradio_mixer_limits(&radio, &rx_max, &tx_max, &sidetone_max);
2766 assert(!rx_max && !tx_max && !sidetone_max);
2767 usbradio_set_sidetone_switch(&radio, 0);
2768 usbradio_set_rx_mixer(&radio, 0);
2769 }
2770
2771 radio.radio_device = NULL;
2772 radio.device_error = AST_RADIO_DEVICE_READY;
2773 modern_acquire_device = &device;
2774 modern_acquire_result = AST_RADIO_DEVICE_WAIT;
2775 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == -1);
2776 assert(radio.device_error == AST_RADIO_DEVICE_WAIT && radio.usb_faulted);
2777 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == -1);
2778 modern_acquire_result = AST_RADIO_DEVICE_READY;
2779 modern_mixer_max = 0;
2780 modern_mixer_max_calls = 0;
2781 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == -1);
2782 assert(radio.device_error == AST_RADIO_DEVICE_ERROR);
2783 modern_mixer_max = 100;
2784 modern_mixer_max_calls = 0;
2785 modern_mixer_max_failure_call = 2;
2786 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == -1);
2787 modern_mixer_max_failure_call = 0;
2788 radio.devstr[0] = '\0';
2789 radio.serial[0] = '\0';
2790 modern_mixer_max_calls = 0;
2791 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == 0);
2792 assert(radio.radio_device == &device && radio.device_error == AST_RADIO_DEVICE_READY);
2793 usbradio_release_device(&radio);
2794 strcpy(radio.devstr, "configured-device");
2795 modern_mixer_max_calls = 0;
2796 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == 0);
2797 usbradio_release_device(&radio);
2798 radio.devstr[0] = '\0';
2799 strcpy(radio.serial, "configured-serial");
2800 modern_mixer_max_calls = 0;
2801 assert(init_audio_device(&radio) == 0);
2802
2803 radio.pa.active = 1;
2804 assert(usbradio_start_audio(&radio) == 0);
2805 radio.pa.active = 0;
2806 radio.radio_device = NULL;
2807 assert(usbradio_start_audio(&radio) == -1);
2808 radio.radio_device = &device;
2809 device.pa_input_channels = 1;
2810 modern_open_result = paUnanticipatedHostError;
2811 assert(usbradio_start_audio(&radio) == -1);
2812 modern_open_result = paNoError;
2813 modern_start_result = paUnanticipatedHostError;
2814 assert(usbradio_start_audio(&radio) == -1);
2815 assert(!radio.pa.active);
2816 modern_start_result = paNoError;
2817 assert(usbradio_start_audio(&radio) == 0);
2818 assert(radio.pa.active && radio.pa.input_channels == 1);
2819 ast_radio_pa_stop(&radio.pa);
2820
2821 {
2822 short output[AST_RADIO_PA_48K_STEREO_SAMPLES] = {1};
2823 short *stereo = (short *)(radio.usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET);
2824
2825 radio.radio_device = NULL;
2826 radio.pa.active = 0;
2827 assert(soundcard_writeframe(&radio, output) == 0);
2828 radio.radio_device = &device;
2829 modern_open_result = paNoError;
2830 modern_start_result = paNoError;
2831 assert(soundcard_writeframe(&radio, output) > 0);
2832 radio.pa.active = 1;
2833 radio.radio = &radio_state;
2834 radio_state.txPttIn = radio_state.txPttOut = 0;
2835 modern_write_result = paNoError;
2836 assert(soundcard_writeframe(&radio, output) ==
2837 AST_RADIO_PA_48K_STEREO_SAMPLES * (int)sizeof(short));
2838 assert(modern_last_write == silence_buf);
2839 radio_state.txPttIn = 1;
2840 modern_write_result = paOutputUnderflowed;
2841 assert(soundcard_writeframe(&radio, output) > 0);
2842 assert(modern_last_write == output);
2843 radio.hasusb = 1;
2844 modern_write_result = paUnanticipatedHostError;
2845 assert(soundcard_writeframe(&radio, output) == 0);
2846 assert(!radio.hasusb && !radio.pa.active);
2847
2848 radio.pa.input_channels = 1;
2849 modern_read_sample = 1234;

2855 radio.pa.input_channels = 2;
2856 modern_read_result = paNoError;
2857 assert(usbradio_read_pa_stereo(&radio) == paNoError);
2858
2859 radio.pa.active = 1;
2860 radio.audio_thread_ready = 1;
2861 radio.swap_state = DEVICE_SWAP_QUIESCING;
2862 stream_cleanup(&radio);
2863 assert(!radio.pa.active && !radio.audio_thread_ready && radio.swap_audio_ready);
2864 }

2921 pthread_create_calls = 0;
2922 fail_pthread_create_call = 0;
2923 assert(usbradio_call(channel, "destination", 1000) == 0);
2924 assert(pthread_create_calls == 2 && setstate_calls > 0);
2925 /* Existing workers are reused on a repeated call. */

2937 radio.hookstate = 0;

2961 assert(!usbradio_request("RadioPlus", formats, NULL, NULL, "modern-test", &cause));
2962 format_compatible = 1;
2963 radio.owner = channel;

2966 radio.owner = NULL;
2967 fail_channel_alloc = 1;

2969 fail_channel_alloc = 0;
2970 radio.owner = NULL;

2972 assert(radio.radio);
2973 assert(usbradio_request("RadioPlus", formats, NULL, NULL, "modern-test", &cause));
2974 assert(!radio.remoted);
2975
2976 usbradioplus_test_set_module_info(NULL);
2977 test_channel_private = NULL;
2978 usbradio_default.next = NULL;
2979 urp_radio_destroy(radio.radio);
2980}

3490 /* Losing USB after the final queued frame reaches the loop condition with
3491 * stop still clear, rather than taking the immediate mid-frame break. */
3492 radio.stopaudiothread = 0;
3493 radio.hasusb = 1;
3494 radio.pa.active = 1;
3495 radio.owner = (struct ast_channel *)(uintptr_t)1;
3496 radio.rxkeyed = radio.lastrx = 1;
3497 modern_drop_hasusb_on_queue = &radio;
3498 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = &radio;
3499 assert(usbradio_audio_thread(&radio) == NULL);
3500 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = NULL;
3501 modern_drop_hasusb_on_queue = NULL;
3502
3503 /* A keyed receiver can disappear without an owner or hardware sidetone. */
3504 radio.stopaudiothread = 0;
3505 radio.hasusb = 1;
3506 radio.pa.active = 1;
3507 radio.owner = NULL;
3508 radio.rxkeyed = 1;
3509 radio.duplex3 = 0;
3510 modern_radio_time_calls = 0;
3511 modern_drop_hasusb_on_time = &radio;
3512 modern_drop_hasusb_on_time_call = 3;
3513 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = &radio;
3514 assert(usbradio_audio_thread(&radio) == NULL);
3515 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = NULL;
3516 modern_drop_hasusb_on_time = NULL;
3517 radio.owner = NULL;
3518
3519 radio.stopaudiothread = 0;
3520 radio.hasusb = 0;
3521 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = &radio;
3522 assert(usbradio_audio_thread(&radio) == NULL);
3523 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = NULL;
3524
3525 radio.stopaudiothread = 0;
3526 radio.hasusb = 1;
3527 radio.pa.active = 0;
3528 modern_open_result = paUnanticipatedHostError;
3529 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = &radio;
3530 assert(usbradio_audio_thread(&radio) == NULL);
3531 modern_stop_audio_on_usleep = NULL;
3532 modern_open_result = paNoError;
3533 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&radio);
3534 urp_radio_destroy(radio.radio);
3535}

3573 radio->rxppsq = (int)(1U << ppinshift[12]);
3574 radio->lasttx = 0;
3575 radio->radio->txPttOut = 1;
3576}

3978static void test_channel_callbacks(void)
3979{
3980 struct chan_usbradio_pvt radio = {0};
3981 urp_radio_state radio_state = {0};
3982 struct ast_channel *channel = (struct ast_channel *)(uintptr_t)1;
3983 char option;
3984

3989 test_channel_private = &radio;
3990 assert(usbradio_digit_begin(channel, '1') == 0);
3991 assert(usbradio_digit_end(channel, '2', 100) == 0);
3992 setstate_calls = 0;
3993 assert(usbradio_answer(channel) == 0 && setstate_calls == 1);
3994 assert(usbradio_fixup(NULL, channel) == 0 && radio.owner == channel);
3995
3996 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_BUSY, NULL, 0) == 0);
3997 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_CONGESTION, NULL, 0) == 0);
3998 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_RINGING, NULL, 0) == 0);
3999 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_VIDUPDATE, NULL, 0) == 0);
4000 moh_start_calls = moh_stop_calls = 0;
4001 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_HOLD, "default", 7) == 0);
4002 assert(moh_start_calls == 1);
4003 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_UNHOLD, NULL, 0) == 0);
4004 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_PROCEEDING, NULL, 0) == 0);
4005 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_PROGRESS, NULL, 0) == 0);
4006 assert(moh_stop_calls == 3);
4007 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_RADIO_KEY, "0", 0) == 0);
4008 assert(radio.txkeyed && !radio.forcetxcode);
4009 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_RADIO_KEY, "0", 1) == 0);
4010 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, AST_CONTROL_RADIO_UNKEY, NULL, 0) == 0);
4011 radio.forcetxcode = 1;

4013 assert(!radio.txkeyed && !radio.forcetxcode);
4014 assert(radio_state.pTxCodeDefault == radio.txctcssdefault);
4015 assert(usbradio_indicate(channel, -1234, NULL, 0) == -1);

4017 assert(usbradio_setoption(channel, AST_OPTION_TONE_VERIFY, NULL, 1) == -1);
4018 assert(usbradio_setoption(channel, AST_OPTION_TONE_VERIFY, &option, 0) == -1);
4019 option = 1;
4020 assert(usbradio_setoption(channel, AST_OPTION_TONE_VERIFY, &option, 1) == 0);
4021 assert(radio.usedtmf);
4022 option = 2;
4023 assert(usbradio_setoption(channel, AST_OPTION_TONE_VERIFY, &option, 1) == 0);
4024 assert(radio.usedtmf);

4216static void test_cli_handlers(void)
4217{
4218 struct ast_cli_entry entry = {0};
4219 struct chan_usbradio_pvt radio = {0};
4220 urp_radio_state template = {0};
4221 const char *key_args[] = {"radioplus", "key"};
4222 const char *tune_args[] = {"radioplus", "tune", "rxsquelch"};
4223 const char *stats_args[] = {"radioplus", "native", "stats", "reset"};
4224 struct ast_cli_args args2 = {.fd = 1, .argc = 2, .argv = key_args};
4225 struct ast_cli_args args3 = {.fd = 1, .argc = 3, .argv = tune_args};
4226 struct ast_cli_args stats3 = {.fd = 1, .argc = 3, .argv = stats_args};
4227 struct ast_cli_args stats4 = {.fd = 1, .argc = 4, .argv = stats_args};
4228 struct ast_cli_args *args = &args2;
4229
4230 assert(res2cli(RESULT_SUCCESS) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4231 assert(res2cli(RESULT_SHOWUSAGE) == CLI_SHOWUSAGE);
4232 assert(res2cli(-999) == CLI_FAILURE);
4233 radio.name = "test";
4234 radio.pttkick[1] = -1;
4235 template.pRxCodeSrc = "100.0";
4236 template.pTxCodeSrc = "100.0";
4237 template.pTxCodeDefault = "100.0";
4238 radio.radio = urp_radio_create(&template, SAMPLES_PER_BLOCK);
4239 assert(radio.radio);
4240 usbradio_default.next = &radio;
4241 usbradio_active = radio.name;
4242
4243#define EXERCISE_HANDLER(handler) \
4244 do { \
4245 assert((handler)(&entry, CLI_INIT, args) == NULL); \
4246 assert((handler)(&entry, CLI_GENERATE, args) == NULL); \
4247 } while (0)
4248 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_console_key);
4249 assert(handle_console_key(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4250 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_console_unkey);
4251 assert(handle_console_unkey(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4252 args = &args3;
4253 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_radio_tune);
4254 assert(handle_radio_tune(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4255 args = &args2;
4256 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_radio_active);
4257 assert(handle_radio_active(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4258 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_show_settings);
4259 assert(handle_show_settings(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4260 usbradio_active = "missing";
4261 assert(handle_show_settings(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4262 usbradio_active = radio.name;
4263 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_set_dsp_debug);
4264 assert(handle_set_dsp_debug(&entry, 0, args) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4265 EXERCISE_HANDLER(handle_radioplus_native_stats);
4266 assert(handle_radioplus_native_stats(&entry, 0, &args2) == CLI_SHOWUSAGE);
4267 assert(handle_radioplus_native_stats(&entry, 0, &stats3) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4268 radio.plus_parrot_playing = 1;
4269 assert(handle_radioplus_native_stats(&entry, 0, &stats3) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4270 radio.plus_parrot_playing = 0;
4271 assert(handle_radioplus_native_stats(&entry, 0, &stats4) == CLI_SUCCESS);
4272 stats_args[3] = "invalid";
4273 assert(handle_radioplus_native_stats(&entry, 0, &stats4) == CLI_SHOWUSAGE);
4274 usbradio_active = "missing";
4275 assert(handle_radioplus_native_stats(&entry, 0, &stats3) == CLI_FAILURE);
4276#undef EXERCISE_HANDLER
4277 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(radio.radio));
4278 usbradio_default.next = NULL;
4279 usbradio_active = NULL;
4280}

5128 radio.plus_applied_txmixaset = (a); \
5129 radio.plus_applied_txmixbset = (b); \

5141 SET_APPLIED(effective_rx, effective_a + 1, effective_b, effective_route_a,
5142 effective_route_b);
5143 refresh_processing_hardware(&radio);
5144 SET_APPLIED(effective_rx, effective_a, effective_b + 1, effective_route_a,
5145 effective_route_b);
5146 refresh_processing_hardware(&radio);
5147 SET_APPLIED(effective_rx, effective_a, effective_b, effective_route_a + 1,
5148 effective_route_b);
5149 refresh_processing_hardware(&radio);
5150 SET_APPLIED(effective_rx, effective_a, effective_b, effective_route_a,
5151 effective_route_b + 1);
5152 refresh_processing_hardware(&radio);
5153#undef SET_APPLIED
5154 radio.rxcdtype = CD_XPMR_VOX;
5155 radio.voxhangtime = 250;
5156 radio.numrxctcssfreqs = 1;
5157 radio.rxctcss[0] = "100.0";
5158 radio.txctcss[0] = "100.0";
5159 assert(call_radio_tune(&radio, 3, "dump", NULL) == RESULT_SUCCESS);
5160 radio.rxcdtype = CD_IGNORE;
5161 radio.numrxctcssfreqs = 0;
5162 radio.radio->numrxcodes = 0;
5163 radio.radio->numtxcodes = 0;
5164#ifdef URP_TEST_MODERN
5165 radio.radio_device = NULL;
5166#endif
5167 assert(call_radio_tune(&radio, 3, "dump", NULL) == RESULT_SUCCESS);
5168 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(radio.radio));
5169 test_config_variables = NULL;

5177static void add_processing_override(const char *section, const char *name, const char *value)
5178{
5179 struct section_override *entry =
5180 &settings.profiles[0].overrides[settings.profiles[0].override_count++];
5181 assert(settings.profiles[0].override_count <= MAX_SECTION_OVERRIDES);
5182 ast_copy_string(entry->section, section, sizeof(entry->section));
5183 ast_copy_string(entry->name, name, sizeof(entry->name));
5184 ast_copy_string(entry->value, value, sizeof(entry->value));
5185}

5491 assert(urp_gain_db_to_mixer(0.0) == 500);

5493 assert(fabs(urp_mixer_to_gain_db(500)) < 0.0001);
5494 assert(urp_mixer_to_gain_db(0) < -100.0);
5495 assert(urp_hardware_level_multiplier(0) == 64);
5496 assert(urp_hardware_level_multiplier(500) > 0);
5497 assert(urp_hardware_level_multiplier(999) > urp_hardware_level_multiplier(500));
5498 assert(urp_pcm_peak_dbfs(0) == -INFINITY);
5499 assert(fabs(urp_pcm_peak_dbfs(32768)) < 0.0001);
5500 assert(fabs(urp_double_peak(samples, ARRAY_LEN(samples)) - 0.75) < 0.0001);
5501 assert(urp_double_peak(samples, 0) == 0.0);
5502 assert(urp_pcm_peak(integer_samples, ARRAY_LEN(integer_samples)) == 32768U);
5503 assert(urp_pcm_peak(integer_samples, 0) == 0U);
5504 assert(urp_saturating_add(100, 200) == 300);
5505 assert(urp_saturating_add(30000, 30000) == 32767);
5506 assert(urp_saturating_add(-30000, -30000) == -32768);
5507 assert(urp_apply_gain(1000, 0.5) == 500);
5508 assert(urp_apply_gain(30000, 2.0) == 32767);
5509 assert(urp_apply_gain(-30000, 2.0) == -32768);
5510 assert(!plus_mix_has_program(TX_OUT_OFF));
5511 assert(plus_mix_has_program(TX_OUT_VOICE));
5512 assert(!plus_mix_has_program(TX_OUT_LSD));
5513 assert(plus_mix_has_program(TX_OUT_COMPOSITE));
5514 assert(plus_mix_has_program(TX_OUT_AUX));
5515}

5685static void test_continuous_soundcard_output(void)
5686{
5687 struct chan_usbradio_pvt radio = {0};
5688 urp_radio_state radio_state = {0};
5689 const short silence[FRAME_SIZE * 2 * 6] = {0};
5690 short output[FRAME_SIZE * 2 * 6];
5691 short original[FRAME_SIZE * 2 * 6];
5692 const int ptt_states[][2] = {{0, 0}, {0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, 1},
5693 {0, 1}, {0, 1}, {0, 0}, {0, 0}};
5694 unsigned int expected_writes = 0;
5695 size_t index;
5696 unsigned int receiver;
5697
5698 radio.name = "continuous-output";
5699 radio.radio = &radio_state;
5700#ifdef URP_TEST_MODERN
5701 radio.pa.active = 1;
5702 modern_write_result = paNoError;
5703#else
5704 radio.sounddev = 7;
5705 radio.total_blocks = 8;
5706 radio.queuesize = 4;
5707 mock_oss_io = 1;
5708 mock_ioctl_failure = ULONG_MAX;
5709 mock_oss_fragment_total = 8;
5710 mock_write_result = -2;
5711#endif
5712 for (index = 0; index < ARRAY_LEN(output); ++index)
5713 output[index] = (short)((index % 2 ? -1 : 1) * (int)(index + 1));
5714 memcpy(original, output, sizeof(original));
5715 mock_sound_write_calls = 0;
5716 for (receiver = 0; receiver < 8; ++receiver) {
5717 radio.rxcarrierdetect = receiver & 1;
5718 radio.rxctcssdecode = (receiver >> 1) & 1;
5719 radio.rxkeyed = (receiver >> 2) & 1;
5720 radio_state.rxCarrierDetect = radio.rxcarrierdetect;
5721 for (index = 0; index < ARRAY_LEN(ptt_states); ++index) {
5722 unsigned int tick;
5723 const short *expected;
5724
5725 radio_state.txPttIn = ptt_states[index][0];
5726 radio_state.txPttOut = ptt_states[index][1];
5727 expected = radio_state.txPttIn || radio_state.txPttOut ? original : silence;
5728 for (tick = 0; tick < 2; ++tick) {
5729#ifndef URP_TEST_MODERN
5730 /* An empty queue must not add a second frame before this tick. */
5731 mock_oss_fragments = 8 - (int)tick;
5732#endif
5733 assert(soundcard_writeframe(&radio, output) == (int)sizeof(output));
5734 assert(mock_sound_write_calls == ++expected_writes);
5735 assert(mock_sound_write_bytes == sizeof(output));
5736 assert(!memcmp(mock_sound_write_data, expected, sizeof(output)));
5737 assert(!memcmp(output, original, sizeof(output)));
5738 assert(radio.plus_sound_dropped_frames == 0);
5739 assert(radio.plus_sound_short_writes == 0);
5740 }
5741 }
5742 }
5743#ifndef URP_TEST_MODERN
5744 mock_oss_io = 0;
5745#endif
5746}

6031static void run_oss_hid_retry(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *radio)
6032{
6033 pthread_t thread;
6034
6035 radio->stophid = 0;
6036 stop_hid_radio_on_usleep = radio;

6038 assert(pthread_join(thread, NULL) == 0);
6039 assert(radio->stophid);
6040 stop_hid_radio_on_usleep = NULL;
6041}

6045{
6046 struct chan_usbradio_pvt radio = {0};
6047 struct chan_usbradio_pvt other = {0};
6048 struct chan_usbradio_pvt candidate = {0};
6049 urp_radio_state radio_state = {0};
6050 pthread_t thread;
6051
6052 radio.name = "test";

6059 mock_usb_device_number = -1;
6060 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6061
6062 mock_usb_device_number = 0;
6063 mock_hid_device_available = 0;
6064 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6065 mock_hid_device_available = 1;
6066 mock_usb_open_success = 0;
6067 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6068 mock_usb_open_success = 1;
6069 mock_usb_claim_calls = 0;
6070 mock_usb_claim_result = -1;
6071 mock_usb_detach_result = -1;
6072 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6073 mock_usb_claim_calls = 0;
6074 mock_usb_detach_result = 0;
6075 mock_usb_second_claim_result = -1;
6076 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6077
6078 /* Automatic assignment reports an empty USB inventory without changing devstr. */
6079 mock_usb_second_claim_result = 0;
6080 radio.devstr[0] = '\0';
6081 radio.serial[0] = '\0';
6082 mock_no_usb_devices = 1;
6083 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6084 assert(!radio.devstr[0]);
6085 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6086 mock_no_usb_devices = 0;
6087
6088 /* Automatic assignment skips an occupied device and records the next serial. */
6089 other.name = "other";
6090 strcpy(other.devstr, "usb-test");
6091 other.usbass = 1;
6092 radio.next = &other;
6093 other.next = NULL;
6094 mock_second_usb_device = 1;
6095 mock_usb_serial_result = 1;
6096 mock_hid_device_available = 0;
6097 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6098 assert(!strcmp(radio.devstr, "usb-second"));
6099 assert(!strcmp(radio.serial, mock_usb_serial));
6100 mock_second_usb_device = 0;
6101 mock_usb_serial_result = 0;
6102
6103 /* Reject a device already owned by another configured channel. */
6104 mock_usb_claim_result = 0;
6105 mock_usb_second_claim_result = 0;
6106 strcpy(other.devstr, "usb-test");
6107 other.usbass = 1;
6108 strcpy(radio.devstr, "usb-test");
6109 radio.next = &other;
6110 other.next = NULL;
6111 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6112
6113 /* Serial enumeration covers missing serials and an exact match. */
6114 other.usbass = 0;
6115 radio.next = NULL;
6116 radio.devstr[0] = '\0';
6117 strcpy(radio.serial, "serial-test");
6118 mock_usb_serial_result = 0;
6119 mock_hid_device_available = 0;
6120 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6121 radio.devstr[0] = '\0';
6122 mock_usb_serial_result = 1;
6123 mock_usb_serial = "different-serial";
6124 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6125 assert(radio.devstr[0]);
6126 mock_usb_serial = "serial-test";
6127 strcpy(radio.serial, "serial-test");
6128 radio.devstr[0] = '\0';
6129 mock_usb_serial_result = 1;
6130 mock_usb_serial_by_device = 1;
6131 mock_second_usb_device = 1;
6132 installed_usb_device = "usb-second";
6133 mock_hid_device_available = 0;
6134 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6135 assert(!strcmp(radio.devstr, "usb-second"));
6136 mock_usb_serial_by_device = 0;
6137 mock_second_usb_device = 0;
6138 installed_usb_device = "usb-test";
6139
6140 /* Assigned nonmatching channels do not block a distinct installed candidate. */
6141 radio.serial[0] = '\0';
6142 strcpy(radio.devstr, "missing");
6143 strcpy(other.devstr, "usb-other");
6144 other.usbass = 1;
6145 strcpy(candidate.devstr, "usb-test");
6146 candidate.usbass = 0;
6147 radio.next = &other;
6148 other.next = &candidate;
6149 candidate.next = NULL;
6150 mock_usb_device_number = 0;
6151 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6152 assert(!strcmp(radio.devstr, "usb-test"));
6153 radio.next = &other;
6154 other.next = NULL;
6155
6156 /* A stale configured device may fall back to an installed configured device. */
6157 radio.serial[0] = '\0';
6158 strcpy(radio.devstr, "missing");
6159 strcpy(other.devstr, "usb-test");
6160 radio.next = &other;
6161 other.usbass = 0;
6162 installed_usb_device = "usb-test";
6163 mock_usb_device_number = -1;
6164 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6165 mock_usb_device_number = 0;
6166 other.usbass = 1;
6167 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6168 other.usbass = 0;
6169 strcpy(radio.devstr, "missing");
6170 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6171 assert(!strcmp(radio.devstr, "usb-test"));
6172 /* Repeated discovery failures suppress duplicate device diagnostics. */
6173 strcpy(radio.devstr, "missing");
6174 radio.device_error = 1;
6175 installed_usb_device = NULL;
6176 run_oss_hid_retry(&radio);
6177 assert(radio.device_error);
6178 installed_usb_device = "usb-test";
6179
6180 /* A detach followed by a successful second claim reaches normal setup. */
6181 radio.pttkick[0] = radio.pttkick[1] = -1;
6182 radio.stophid = 0;
6183 mock_hid_device_available = 1;
6184 mock_usb_open_success = 1;
6185 mock_usb_claim_calls = 0;
6186 mock_usb_claim_result = -1;
6187 mock_usb_second_claim_result = 0;
6188 mock_usb_detach_result = 0;
6189 mock_pipe_failure = 1;
6190 assert(pthread_create(&thread, NULL, hidthread, &radio) == 0);
6191 assert(pthread_join(thread, NULL) == 0);
6192 mock_pipe_failure = 0;
6193 mock_usb_claim_result = 0;
6194
6195 /* Once attachment succeeds, pipe creation failure terminates the worker. */
6196 radio.pttkick[0] = radio.pttkick[1] = -1;
6197 mock_hid_device_available = 1;
6198 mock_usb_open_success = 1;
6199 mock_pipe_failure = 1;
6200 radio.stophid = 0;
6201 assert(pthread_create(&thread, NULL, hidthread, &radio) == 0);
6202 assert(pthread_join(thread, NULL) == 0);
6203 assert(radio.pttkick[0] == -1 && radio.pttkick[1] == -1);
6204 mock_pipe_failure = 0;
6205
6206 mock_usb_serial_result = 0;
6207 mock_hid_device_available = 0;
6208 mock_usb_open_success = 0;
6209 mock_usb_claim_result = 0;
6210 mock_usb_second_claim_result = 0;
6211 mock_usb_detach_result = 0;
6212 mock_usb_device_number = 0;
6213 mock_no_usb_devices = 0;
6214 mock_second_usb_device = 0;
6215 installed_usb_device = NULL;
6216 usbradio_default.next = NULL;
6217}

6427 mock_tvnow_step = 0;

6788static struct ast_frame *oss_read_complete(struct chan_usbradio_pvt *radio,
6789 struct ast_channel *channel)
6790{
6791 struct ast_frame *frame;
6792 unsigned int writes_before = mock_sound_write_calls;
6793
6794 mock_read_result = (ssize_t)(sizeof(radio->usbradio_read_buf) - radio->readpos);
6795 frame = usbradio_read(channel);
6796 assert(mock_sound_write_calls == writes_before + 1);
6797 assert(mock_sound_write_bytes == sizeof(radio->usbradio_write_buf));
6798 assert(radio->plus_sound_dropped_frames == 0);
6799 assert(radio->plus_sound_short_writes == 0);
6800 return frame;
6801}

7104 radio.count_rssi_update = 1;

7106 radio.rxhidsq = 1;
7107 assert(oss_read_complete(&radio, channel) == &radio.read_f);
7108 assert(!radio.radio->b.txCtcssReady && radio.count_rssi_update == 10);
7109 radio.count_rssi_update = 0;
7110 assert(oss_read_complete(&radio, channel) == &radio.read_f);
7111 radio.count_rssi_update = 3;
7112 radio.rxkeyed = 1;
7113 radio.rxhidsq = 1;
7114 assert(oss_read_complete(&radio, channel) == &radio.read_f);
7115 assert(radio.count_rssi_update == 2);
7116 radio.count_rssi_update = 1;
7117 radio.rxkeyed = 0;
7118 radio.rxhidsq = 0;
7119 assert(oss_read_complete(&radio, channel) == &radio.read_f);
7120
7121 /* Asterisk's detector may mute reserved digits, return ordinary digits, or
7122 * suppress a duplicate begin frame while retaining the voice frame. */
7123 radio.usedtmf = 1;
7124 radio.dsp = NULL;
7125 assert(oss_read_complete(&radio, channel) == &radio.read_f);
7126 radio.dsp = (struct ast_dsp *)(uintptr_t)1;
7127 dsp_result_type = AST_FRAME_VOICE;
7128 assert(oss_read_complete(&radio, channel) == &radio.read_f);
7129 dsp_result_type = AST_FRAME_DTMF_END;
7130 dsp_result_digit = 'm';
7131 frame = oss_read_complete(&radio, channel);
7132 assert(frame->frametype == AST_FRAME_NULL && !frame->subclass.integer);
7133 dsp_result_type = AST_FRAME_DTMF_END;
7134 dsp_result_digit = 'u';
7135 frame = oss_read_complete(&radio, channel);
7136 assert(frame->frametype == AST_FRAME_NULL && !frame->subclass.integer);
7137 dsp_result_type = AST_FRAME_DTMF_END;
7138 dsp_result_digit = '5';
7139 option_verbose = 1;
7140 frame = oss_read_complete(&radio, channel);
7141 assert(frame->frametype == AST_FRAME_DTMF_END && !radio.toneflag);
7142 option_verbose = 0;
7143 dsp_result_type = AST_FRAME_DTMF_END;
7144 dsp_result_digit = '7';
7145 frame = oss_read_complete(&radio, channel);
7146 assert(frame->frametype == AST_FRAME_DTMF_END);
7147 dsp_result_type = AST_FRAME_DTMF_BEGIN;
7148 dsp_result_digit = '6';
7149 radio.toneflag = 0;
7150 frame = oss_read_complete(&radio, channel);
7151 assert(frame->frametype == AST_FRAME_DTMF_BEGIN && radio.toneflag);
7152 frame_free_calls = 0;
7153 radio.toneflag = 1;
7154 frame = oss_read_complete(&radio, channel);
7155 assert(frame == &radio.read_f && frame_free_calls == 1);
7156 dsp_result_type = -1;
7157 radio.usedtmf = 0;
7158 radio.dsp = NULL;
7159
7160 mock_read_result = -1;
7161 option_debug = 0;
7162 module_debug_level = file_debug_level = 0;
7163 mock_oss_io = 0;
7164 test_channel_private = NULL;
7165 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&radio);
7166 urp_radio_destroy(radio.radio);
7167}

7282
7283 for (i = 0; i < ARRAY_LEN(radio.plus_squelch_native); i++)
7284 capture[i] = (short)(i - 100);
7285 usbradioplus_prepare_squelch_audio(&radio);
7286 assert(memcmp(capture, radio.plus_squelch_native, sizeof(radio.plus_squelch_native)) == 0);

7316static void test_program_queue_and_parrot_storage(void)

7373 fail_realloc = 1;

7438 assert(channel.plus_link_queue_underflows == 1);
7439 assert(!urp_native_fifo_push(&channel.plus_native_fifo, native_program,
7440 ARRAY_LEN(native_program)));
7441 channel.plus_native_fifo.primed = 1;
7442 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7443 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.stable_blocks == 1);

7445 settings.profiles[0].enabled = 1;
7446 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL].enabled = 1;
7447 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL].rnnoise_enabled = 1;

7512 * unit only and invoke the real libraries on every nonselected call. */

7558 partial_src_process_call = 0;

7576 channel.duplex3 = 999;
7577 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7578 channel.rxkeyed = 1;
7579 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7580 channel.duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE;
7581 channel.usedtmf = 1;

7599
7600 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL].input_gain_configured = 1;
7601 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL].ctcss_filter_configured = 0;
7602 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7603
7604 channel.plus_parrot_count = 2 * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES;
7605 channel.plus_parrot_play = 0;
7606 channel.plus_parrot_playing = 1;
7607 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7608 assert(channel.plus_parrot_playing);
7609 channel.plus_parrot_playing = 0;
7610 channel.plus_parrot_state.playing = 0;
7611 channel.rxkeyed = 1;
7612 channel.duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE;
7613 channel.echomode = 1;
7614 double *saved_parrot = channel.plus_parrot;
7615 channel.plus_parrot = NULL;
7616 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7617 channel.plus_parrot = saved_parrot;
7618 channel.echomode = 0;
7619 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7620
7621 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].splatter_filter_configured = 0;
7622 channel.txhpf = 1;
7623 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7624 channel.txlpf = 1;
7625 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7626 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].agc.output_highpass_hz = 0.0;
7627 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].agc.output_lowpass_hz = 1000.0;
7628 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7629 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].agc.output_highpass_hz = 500.0;
7630 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].agc.output_lowpass_hz = 0.0;
7631 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7632 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].agc.output_highpass_hz = 5000.0;
7633 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_VOICE_TELEMETRY].agc.output_lowpass_hz = 1000.0;
7634 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7635 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
7636 urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio);

7641static void check_native_fifo_short_burst(unsigned int target_samples)
7642{
7643 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
7644 urp_radio_state radio_config = {
7645 .pRxCodeSrc = "0", .pTxCodeSrc = "0", .pTxCodeDefault = "0"};
7646 short program[URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES];
7647
7648 settings_defaults(&settings);
7649 strcpy(settings.profiles[0].name, "fifo-burst");
7650 strcpy(settings.profiles[0].channel, "RadioPlus/fifo-burst");
7651 settings.profiles[0].enabled = 0;
7652 channel.name = "fifo-burst";
7653 channel.plus_app_rpt_rate = URP_RATE_NATIVE;
7654 channel.plus_app_rpt_samples = URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES;
7655 channel.plus_emphasis_corner_hz = 300.0;
7656 channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples = target_samples;
7657 channel.txkeyed = 1;
7658 channel.radio = urp_radio_create(&radio_config, URP_LINK_SAMPLES);
7659 assert(channel.radio);
7660 assert(!usbradioplus_dsp_init(&channel));
7661 for (size_t i = 0; i < ARRAY_LEN(program); ++i)
7662 program[i] = 1000;
7663
7664 for (unsigned int burst = 0; burst < 2; ++burst) {
7665 unsigned int frames =
7666 (target_samples + URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES - 1U) / URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES;
7667 usbradioplus_queue_program(&channel, program, ARRAY_LEN(program));
7668 assert(channel.plus_program_queue.count == frames);
7669 assert(!channel.plus_link_queue_overflows);
7670 for (unsigned int frame = 0; frame < frames; ++frame) {
7671 /* Recovery blends its preceding concealment into the first millisecond. */
7672 size_t first_sample = burst && !frame ? URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES / 20U : 0;
7673 src_process_calls = 0;
7674 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7675 assert(!src_process_calls && !channel.plus_link_src_pending);
7676 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.primed);
7677 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples == target_samples);
7678 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples >=
7679 110U * (URP_RATE_NATIVE / 1000U));
7680 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.count ==
7681 (frames - frame - 1U) * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES);
7682 for (size_t i = first_sample; i < ARRAY_LEN(program); ++i)
7683 assert(channel.plus_link_native[i] ==
7684 (frame + 1U == frames ? program[i] : 0));
7685 }
7686 assert(!channel.plus_program_queue.count);
7687 assert(channel.plus_link_queue_underflows == burst);
7688 /* A keyed empty tick raises the target and resets startup buffering. */
7689 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7690 assert(!channel.plus_native_fifo.primed && !channel.plus_native_fifo.count);
7691 assert(channel.plus_link_queue_underflows == burst + 1U);
7692 target_samples = target_samples < URP_FIFO_TARGET_MAX
7693 ? target_samples + URP_FIFO_TARGET_STEP
7694 : URP_FIFO_TARGET_MAX;
7695 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples == target_samples);
7696 assert(!channel.plus_link_queue_overflows);
7697 }
7698 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
7699 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio));
7700}

7703static void test_native_fifo_short_bursts(void)
7704{
7705 check_native_fifo_short_burst(URP_FIFO_TARGET_MIN);
7706 check_native_fifo_short_burst(URP_FIFO_TARGET_NORMAL);
7707 check_native_fifo_short_burst(URP_FIFO_TARGET_MAX);
7708}

7740static void test_local_processing_cpu_saver(void)
7741{
7742 const struct {
7743 int saver;
7744 int keyed;
7745 int runs;
7746 } cases[] = {{0, 0, 1}, {0, 1, 1}, {1, 0, 0}, {1, 1, 1}};
7747
7748 for (unsigned int enabled = 0; enabled < 2; ++enabled) {
7749 for (unsigned int rnnoise = 0; rnnoise < 2; ++rnnoise) {
7750 for (size_t scenario = 0; scenario < ARRAY_LEN(cases); ++scenario) {
7751 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
7752 short *capture =
7753 (short *)(channel.usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET);
7754 unsigned long long dynamics_before, filter_before, after;
7755 uint64_t rnnoise_before, startup_before;
7756 int runs = enabled && cases[scenario].runs;
7757
7758 initialize_src_burst_channel(&channel, URP_FIFO_TARGET_NORMAL,
7759 URP_RATE_NATIVE, 0);
7760 settings.profiles[0].enabled = 1;
7761 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL].enabled = enabled;
7762 settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL].rnnoise_enabled = rnnoise;
7763 strcpy(settings.profiles[0].hardware.cos_assignment, "usb");
7764 channel.rxcpusaver = cases[scenario].saver;
7765 channel.rxkeyed = 1;
7766 for (size_t i = 0; i < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES; ++i)
7767 capture[2 * i] =
7768 (short)(3000.0 * sin(2.0 * M_PI * i / 48.0));
7769 for (unsigned int tick = 0; tick < 4; ++tick)
7770 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7771 dynamics_before = channel.plus_local_avfilter.input_samples;
7772 filter_before = channel.plus_rx_filter.input_samples;
7773 rnnoise_before = channel.plus_local_rnnoise.rnnoise_frames;
7774 startup_before = channel.plus_local_rnnoise.startup_samples;
7775 assert(dynamics_before == (enabled ? 4U * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES : 0));
7776 channel.rxkeyed = cases[scenario].keyed;
7777 for (unsigned int tick = 0; tick < 3; ++tick)
7778 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7779 after = channel.plus_local_avfilter.input_samples;
7780 assert(after ==
7781 dynamics_before + (runs ? 3U * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES : 0));
7782 assert(channel.plus_rx_filter.input_samples ==
7783 filter_before + 3U * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES);
7784 assert(!channel.plus_local_avfilter.failed);
7785 assert(!channel.plus_local_rnnoise.errors);
7786 if (runs && rnnoise) {
7787 assert(channel.plus_local_rnnoise.active);
7788 assert(channel.plus_local_rnnoise.rnnoise_frames >
7789 rnnoise_before);
7790 assert(channel.plus_local_rnnoise.startup_samples ==
7791 startup_before);
7792 } else {
7793 assert(!channel.plus_local_rnnoise.active);
7794 assert(channel.plus_local_rnnoise.rnnoise_frames ==
7795 rnnoise_before);
7796 }
7797 /* Reopening receive resumes the optional stages when enabled. */
7798 channel.rxkeyed = 1;
7799 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7800 assert(channel.plus_local_avfilter.input_samples ==
7801 after + (enabled ? URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES : 0));
7802 assert(channel.plus_local_rnnoise.active ==
7803 (int)(enabled && rnnoise));
7804 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
7805 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio));
7806 }
7807 }
7808 }
7809}

7816static void check_resampled_fifo_short_burst(unsigned int target_samples, unsigned int input_rate,
7817 int keyed)
7818{
7819 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
7820 short program[URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES];
7821 size_t program_samples = input_rate / 50U;
7822 double input_energy = 0.0;
7823
7824 initialize_src_burst_channel(&channel, target_samples, input_rate, keyed);
7825 for (size_t i = 0; i < program_samples; ++i) {
7826 double frequency = i < 3U * program_samples / 4U ? 1000.0 : 2000.0;
7827 program[i] = (short)(5000.0 * sin(2.0 * M_PI * frequency * i / input_rate));
7828 input_energy += (double)program[i] * program[i];
7829 }
7830
7831 for (unsigned int burst = 0; burst < 2; ++burst) {
7832 unsigned int max_ticks =
7833 (target_samples + URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES - 1U) / URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES + 3U;
7834 double output_energy = 0.0;
7835 double tail_sine = 0.0, tail_cosine = 0.0;
7836 unsigned int tick;
7837
7838 /* No later program frame is available to satisfy the sinc filter's lookahead. */
7839 usbradioplus_queue_program(&channel, program, program_samples);
7840 assert(channel.plus_program_queue.count <= URP_PROGRAM_QUEUE_FRAMES);
7841 for (tick = 0; tick < max_ticks; ++tick) {
7842 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7843 if (!tick)
7844 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.primed);
7845 assert(channel.txkeyed == keyed);
7846 assert(!channel.plus_link_queue_overflows && !channel.plus_src_errors);
7847 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples >= URP_FIFO_TARGET_MIN);
7848 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples <= URP_FIFO_TARGET_MAX);
7849 for (size_t i = 0; i < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES; ++i) {
7850 double phase = 2.0 * M_PI * 2000.0 *
7851 (tick * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES + i) / URP_RATE_NATIVE;
7852 output_energy += (double)channel.plus_link_native[i] *
7853 channel.plus_link_native[i];
7854 tail_sine += channel.plus_link_native[i] * sin(phase);
7855 tail_cosine += channel.plus_link_native[i] * cos(phase);
7856 }
7857 if (!channel.plus_native_fifo.primed)
7858 break;
7859 }
7860 assert(tick < max_ticks);
7861 assert(!channel.plus_program_queue.count && !channel.plus_native_fifo.count);
7862 assert(!channel.plus_link_src_pending);
7863 /* Preserve most of the tone, allowing sinc ringing and the final concealment fade.
7864 */
7865 assert(output_energy >=
7866 0.70 * input_energy * ((double)URP_RATE_NATIVE / input_rate));
7867 /* The final 5 ms marker must escape the SRC, not just the initial voice energy. */
7868 assert(hypot(tail_sine, tail_cosine) > 0.70 * 5000.0 * URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES / 8.0);
7869 assert(channel.plus_link_queue_underflows == (keyed ? burst + 1U : 0));
7870 if (keyed && target_samples < URP_FIFO_TARGET_MAX)
7871 target_samples += URP_FIFO_TARGET_STEP;
7872 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples == target_samples);
7873 }
7874 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
7875 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio));
7876}

7895static void assert_resampled_stream_matches(const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *channel,
7896 const struct chan_usbradio_pvt *reference)
7897{
7898 assert(!memcmp(channel->plus_link_native, reference->plus_link_native,
7899 sizeof(channel->plus_link_native)));
7900 assert(!memcmp(channel->usbradio_write_buf, reference->usbradio_write_buf,
7901 sizeof(channel->usbradio_write_buf)));
7902 assert(channel->plus_native_fifo.head == reference->plus_native_fifo.head);
7903 assert(channel->plus_native_fifo.count == reference->plus_native_fifo.count);
7904 assert(channel->plus_native_fifo.primed == reference->plus_native_fifo.primed);
7905 assert(channel->plus_native_fifo.have_history == reference->plus_native_fifo.have_history);
7906 assert(channel->plus_native_fifo.concealing == reference->plus_native_fifo.concealing);
7907 assert(channel->plus_native_fifo.target_samples ==
7908 reference->plus_native_fifo.target_samples);
7909 assert(!memcmp(channel->plus_native_fifo.history, reference->plus_native_fifo.history,
7910 sizeof(channel->plus_native_fifo.history)));
7911 assert(channel->plus_link_src_pending == reference->plus_link_src_pending);
7912 assert(channel->plus_link_clock.correction == reference->plus_link_clock.correction);
7913 assert(channel->plus_link_clock.filtered_error ==
7914 reference->plus_link_clock.filtered_error);
7915 assert(channel->plus_link_clock.integral_error ==
7916 reference->plus_link_clock.integral_error);
7917 assert(!channel->plus_link_queue_underflows && !channel->plus_link_queue_overflows);
7918 assert(!channel->plus_src_errors);
7919}

7922static void test_resampled_fifo_continuity_and_rekey(void)
7923{
7924 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
7925 struct chan_usbradio_pvt reference = {0};
7926 struct ast_channel *owner = (struct ast_channel *)(uintptr_t)1;
7927 short program[URP_LINK_SAMPLES];
7928 short silence[URP_LINK_SAMPLES] = {0};
7929 struct ast_frame voice = {
7930 .frametype = AST_FRAME_VOICE, .data.ptr = program, .datalen = sizeof(program)};
7931 const int keyed[] = {0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0};
7932 unsigned int stable_blocks = 0;
7933 double expected_energy = 0.0;
7934
7935 initialize_src_burst_channel(&channel, URP_FIFO_TARGET_NORMAL, URP_RATE_LINK, 0);
7936 initialize_src_burst_channel(&reference, URP_FIFO_TARGET_NORMAL, URP_RATE_LINK, 1);
7937 channel.hasusb = 1;
7938#ifdef URP_TEST_MODERN
7939 channel.audio_thread_ready = 1;
7940#else
7941 channel.sounddev = 7;
7942#endif
7943 test_channel_private = &channel;
7944 for (size_t i = 0; i < ARRAY_LEN(program); ++i) {
7945 program[i] = (short)(5000.0 * sin(2.0 * M_PI * 1000.0 * i / URP_RATE_LINK));
7946 expected_energy +=
7947 (double)program[i] * program[i] * ((double)URP_RATE_NATIVE / URP_RATE_LINK);
7948 }
7949 for (unsigned int frame = 0; frame < 24; ++frame) {
7950 double energy = 0.0;
7951 unsigned int queued = channel.plus_program_queue.count;
7952
7953 channel.txkeyed = keyed[frame % ARRAY_LEN(keyed)];
7954 /* Idle silence and unkeyed voice both belong to the same input stream. */
7955 voice.data.ptr = frame >= 16 && frame < 20 ? silence : program;
7956 channel.echoing = 1;
7957 assert(!usbradio_write(owner, &voice));
7958 assert(channel.plus_program_queue.count == queued);
7959 channel.echoing = 0;
7960 assert(!usbradio_write(owner, &voice));
7961 assert(channel.plus_program_queue.count > queued);
7962 usbradioplus_queue_program(&reference, voice.data.ptr, ARRAY_LEN(program));
7963 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7964 usbradioplus_native_tick(&reference);
7965 assert_resampled_stream_matches(&channel, &reference);
7966 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.primed && channel.plus_link_src_pending);
7967 stable_blocks += channel.txkeyed;
7968 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.stable_blocks == stable_blocks);
7969 for (size_t i = 0; i < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES; ++i)
7970 energy += (double)channel.plus_link_native[i] * channel.plus_link_native[i];
7971 /* Once startup silence passes, padding must not introduce gaps between frames. */
7972 if (frame >= 8 && frame < 16)
7973 assert(energy > 0.90 * expected_energy && energy < 1.10 * expected_energy);
7974 }
7975
7976 /* Key changes also preserve buffered audio when no new frame arrives that tick. */
7977 for (unsigned int tick = 0; tick < 3; ++tick) {
7978 channel.txkeyed = tick % 2;
7979 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
7980 usbradioplus_native_tick(&reference);
7981 assert_resampled_stream_matches(&channel, &reference);
7982 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.primed && channel.plus_link_src_pending);
7983 stable_blocks += channel.txkeyed;
7984 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.stable_blocks == stable_blocks);
7985 }
7986 test_channel_private = NULL;
7987 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
7988 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&reference);
7989 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio));
7990 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(reference.radio));
7991}

7994static void test_resampled_fifo_tail_failures(void)
7995{
7996 for (unsigned int failure = 0; failure < 2; ++failure) {
7997 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
7998 short program[URP_LINK_SAMPLES] = {0};
7999
8000 initialize_src_burst_channel(&channel, URP_FIFO_TARGET_NORMAL, URP_RATE_LINK, 1);
8001 usbradioplus_queue_program(&channel, program, ARRAY_LEN(program));
8002 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
8003 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.primed);
8004 for (unsigned int tick = 0; tick < URP_PROGRAM_QUEUE_FRAMES &&
8005 channel.plus_native_fifo.count >= URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES;
8006 ++tick)
8007 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
8008 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.count < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES);
8009 assert(channel.plus_link_src_pending && !channel.plus_program_queue.count);
8010 src_process_calls = 0;
8011 if (failure)
8012 partial_src_process_call = 2;
8013 else
8014 fail_src_process_call = 2;
8015 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
8016 assert(src_process_calls == 2); /* Receive downsampling, then the synthetic tail. */
8017 assert(channel.plus_src_errors == 1 && channel.plus_link_queue_underflows == 1);
8018 assert(!channel.plus_link_src_pending && !channel.plus_native_fifo.primed);
8019 assert(!channel.plus_native_fifo.count && !channel.plus_link_queue_overflows);
8020 assert(channel.plus_native_fifo.target_samples ==
8021 URP_FIFO_TARGET_NORMAL + URP_FIFO_TARGET_STEP);
8022 fail_src_process_call = 0;
8023 partial_src_process_call = 0;
8024 src_process_calls = 0;
8025 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
8026 assert(src_process_calls == 1);
8027 assert(channel.plus_src_errors == 1 && channel.plus_link_queue_underflows == 1);
8028 assert(!channel.plus_link_src_pending && channel.txkeyed);
8029 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
8030 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio));
8031 }

8035static void test_native_sample_gate(void)
8036{
8037 struct chan_usbradio_pvt channel = {0};
8038 urp_radio_state radio_config = {
8039 .pRxCodeSrc = "0", .pTxCodeSrc = "0", .pTxCodeDefault = "0"};
8040 static const char *const carrier_sources[] = {"dsp", "usb", "usbinvert", "vox",
8041 "pp", "ppinvert", "no"};
8042 short *capture = (short *)(channel.usbradio_read_buf + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET);
8043 short *network = (short *)(channel.usbradio_read_buf_8k + AST_FRIENDLY_OFFSET);
8044
8045 settings_defaults(&settings);
8046 strcpy(settings.profiles[0].name, "sample-gate");
8047 strcpy(settings.profiles[0].channel, "RadioPlus/sample-gate");
8048 settings.profiles[0].enabled = 0;
8049 memset(&settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL], 0,
8050 sizeof(settings.profiles[0].chains[TXAGC_LOCAL]));
8051 channel.name = "sample-gate";
8052 channel.rxdemod = RX_AUDIO_SPEAKER;
8053 channel.rxkeyed = 1; /* Adapter metadata still describes the previous frame. */
8054 channel.duplex3 = 999;
8055 channel.duplex3mode = DUPLEX3_MODE_SOFTWARE;
8056 channel.plus_app_rpt_rate = URP_RATE_NATIVE;
8057 channel.plus_app_rpt_samples = URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES;
8058 channel.plus_emphasis_corner_hz = 300.0;
8059 channel.radio = urp_radio_create(&radio_config, URP_LINK_SAMPLES);
8060 assert(channel.radio);
8061 assert(!usbradioplus_dsp_init(&channel));
8062 for (size_t i = 0; i < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES; ++i) {
8063 capture[2 * i] = 1000;
8064 channel.radio->rxCarrierGate[i] = i < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES / 2;
8065 }
8066
8067 for (size_t source = 0; source < ARRAY_LEN(carrier_sources); ++source) {
8068 strcpy(settings.profiles[0].hardware.cos_assignment, carrier_sources[source]);
8069 usbradioplus_native_tick(&channel);
8070 for (size_t i = 0; i < URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES; ++i) {
8071 double expected = source == 0 && i >= URP_NATIVE_SAMPLES / 2 ? 0.0 : 1000.0;
8072 assert(channel.plus_local_native[i] == expected);
8073 assert(network[i] == expected);
8074 }
8075 assert(channel.rxkeyed); /* No changes to carrier, CTCSS, or PTT qualification. */
8076 assert(!channel.radio->txPttIn && !channel.radio->txPttOut);
8077 }
8078 usbradioplus_dsp_destroy(&channel);
8079 assert(!urp_radio_destroy(channel.radio));
8080}
